hikes.name: Tumalo Falls and Double Falls
hikes.blurb: A 97-foot falls over the edge of an old burn, then up the North Fork past a run of smaller falls.

hikes.name: Black Butte
hikes.blurb: A short, steep climb up a lone cone to a lookout with the whole Central Oregon Cascades in a row.

hikes.name: Paulina Peak
hikes.blurb: To the highest point of the Newberry caldera rim, above two lakes and a huge black obsidian flow.

hikes.name: Deschutes River: Lava Island to Dillon Falls
hikes.blurb: The river trail west of Bend through pines and lava, past churning rapids to a falls in a lava gorge.

hikes.name: Steelhead Falls
hikes.blurb: Down into the Deschutes canyon to a short, wide falls with basalt walls all around.

hikes.name: Paulina Lake Loop
hikes.blurb: Around a caldera lake past beaches, hot springs at the shore and the edge of an obsidian flow.

hikes.name: Paulina Falls
hikes.blurb: A short walk to a twin falls pouring 80 feet out of the Newberry caldera.

hikes.name: Pilot Butte
hikes.blurb: Bend's in-town cinder cone: a spiral path to a summit with every Cascade peak from Hood to Bachelor.

hikes.name: Head of the Metolius
hikes.blurb: A few minutes to where a full-sized river bursts out of the hillside under Mt Jefferson.

hikes.name: Big Obsidian Flow
hikes.blurb: Stairs up onto Oregon's youngest lava flow, a glassy black field of obsidian 1,300 years old.

hikes.name: Gray Butte
hikes.blurb: Juniper slopes behind Smith Rock to a summit that looks down on the climbing walls and across to the Cascades.

hikes.name: Benham Falls
hikes.blurb: From Sunriver Resort Admin Parking, a 12.6-mile round trip to Benham Falls, with about 450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Three Creek Lake
hikes.blurb: From Three Creek Meadow Trailhead, a 2.2-mile round trip to Three Creek Lake.

hikes.name: Skeleton Cave
hikes.blurb: From Bessie Butte Trailhead, an 11.7-mile round trip to Skeleton Cave, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tam McArthur Rim
hikes.blurb: From Tam McArthur Rim Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to Tam McArthur Rim, with about 1,350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: McKay Crossing Falls
hikes.blurb: From Ten Mile Sno-Park, a 7.2-mile round trip to McKay Crossing Falls, with about 1,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Paulina Hot Springs
hikes.blurb: From Big Obsidian Flow Trailhead, a 5.7-mile round trip to Paulina Hot Springs, with about 700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Upper Tumalo Falls
hikes.blurb: From Tumalo Falls Trailhead, a 3.8-mile round trip to Upper Tumalo Falls, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dry Falls
hikes.blurb: From Alder Springs Trailhead, a 2.0-mile round trip to Dry Falls, with about 350 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Whychus Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Whychus Overlook, a 1.9-mile round trip to Whychus Creek Falls.

hikes.name: Austin Creson Viewpoint
hikes.blurb: From Gray Butte Saddle Trailhead, a 3.8-mile round trip to Austin Creson Viewpoint, with about 750 feet of climbing.
